why_this_supersedes.root_cause: On the Boolean universe these charges ARE classified by polymorphism conditions (Schaefer; Barto-Kozik; KSTW; Creignou-Hermann). The dichotomy theorems ARE the bridge, proven cell by cell. 'Does structure predict fate?' is a THEOREM there, not a hypothesis. rev-3's P1 tautology and P4 lookup are that one fact wearing two hats.
why_this_supersedes.the_designs_own_rule_killed_it: rev-3 §0.4 stated 'headline accuracy is net-of-forced'. Applied honestly: the joint profile is a deterministic function of the 10 Post flags (46 flag-vectors -> 46 profiles, ZERO ambiguity, 100% ceiling; 93.87% exact from arity<=3's 90 rows alone). Every point of P4's accuracy is theorem-forced. The netting rule zeroes the headline it was written to protect.

It would add a 2-VALUED column collinear with flags already driving decision/localization/parallelization — a COUNT of three without a third independent partition.
grounding_corrections_recorded.C2_objective_axis_is_one_charge_wide: only `approximation` responds to the objective. `parameterized` is objective-independent by construction AND by pin; the other six are relation-level. Flag 1 was a special case: SEVEN of eight charge x objective components are DEFINITIONALLY zero.
grounding_corrections_recorded.C3_determinism: 46 distinct flag-vectors over 4072 classes; 0 map to more than one profile. Lookup ceiling 100.00%. Arity<=3 lookup (90 rows) scores 93.87% exact / 95.38% Hamming on the 3982-class arity-4 holdout. poly_fingerprint IS those flags and is passport-admissible.
grounding_corrections_recorded.C4_P1_tautology: bounded-width => decision in P holds 3178/3178 because both derive from the same Post-class membership. The BICONDITIONAL rev-3 stated is FALSE: 4 arity-4 affine classes are unbounded-width yet tractable.
grounding_corrections_recorded.C5_P3_definitional_tie: the engine-split 2x2's association IS the NPC => feasibility-hard tie (all 890 unbounded-width SAME rows are exactly the NPC rows). Netted, the unbounded arm has 4 rows and one EMPTY cell. prereg_v33 already dropped this same confound as its preds 3 & 4.
grounding_corrections_recorded.C6_nulls: joint-modal null is weak (21.86%); the HONEST Hamming null is per-charge modal = 74.45%. counting (98.1%) and approx_counting (96.8%) are near-constant, ~24 points of free Hamming. decision=NPC structurally entails four other charges on 21.9% of rows.

A1_surface_recovers_algebra.question: Is the algebraic classification recoverable from RAW COMBINATORICS?
A1_surface_recovers_algebra.features: SURFACE ONLY — arity, tuple density, orbit/class size, tuple-set shape. ALL 10 Post flags and everything derived from them (engine_type, localization) are EXCLUDED BY SEALED RULE.
A1_surface_recovers_algebra.prediction: surface features recover the joint charge profile on held-out folds above the per-charge modal null (74.45% Hamming), with CIs clear.
A1_surface_recovers_algebra.ceiling_stated_in_advance: 100% — the profile is a deterministic function of the flags (C3). The ceiling is a property of the population, not a result.
A1_surface_recovers_algebra.null: PER-CHARGE modal baseline (74.45% Hamming), NOT joint-modal (41.20%). Joint-modal would flatter the result.
A1_surface_recovers_algebra.scored_either_way: a MISS is a clean result: it would say the algebraic invariants are IRREDUCIBLE from surface combinatorics, which is itself the answer to why the natural atlas has no engine column.

A2_per_flag_recovery.rationale: since the profile is deterministic in the flags, surface->profile accuracy FACTORS THROUGH surface->flags recoverability.
A2_per_flag_recovery.deliverable: per-flag recovery reported BESIDE profile accuracy. If surface combinatorics recover affine-ness but not bounded-width (or the reverse), that is the finding at its natural resolution. Free given the machinery.

B1_natural_prediction.arm: B (natural atlas, 345 rows — PROMOTED from exploratory to sealed, owner ruling 2026-07-25)
B1_natural_prediction.question: Do Anatomy coordinates predict CITED charges out-of-sample?
B1_natural_prediction.why_this_is_now_the_main_event: the synthetic universe cannot test the bridge because there the bridge is a theorem (C3). The empirical bridge question therefore lives ENTIRELY on the natural side, where charges are cited facts about the literature rather than computed functions of structure.
B1_natural_prediction.prediction: Anatomy coordinates predict held-out natural rows' cited charges above each charge's own marginal mode, with CIs clear, under the full contamination protocol.

fold_key.warrant_recorded_verbatim_because_it_loo: Using flag-groups as the FOLD KEY while excluding flags as FEATURES is legal and correct: the key only prevents identical-profile near-duplicates from straddling train/test, which makes the test STRICTLY HARDER, NEVER EASIER. Nothing about the key enters the fit.
fold_key.hazard_noted: structure.cluster() and crucible._battery() already take a `families` argument meaning ProblemEntry.problem_family — a DIFFERENT notion. Do not overload it silently.

boundary_stratification.quantity: boundary distance = minimum tuple-edits to flip the engine predicate
boundary_stratification.ruling: flag-derived, therefore BARRED AS A FEATURE but LEGAL AS A STRATIFICATION VARIABLE — reporting accuracy BY boundary distance leaks nothing into the fit.
boundary_stratification.deliverable: sealed. A model accurate in the interiors and coin-flip at the line has learned geography, not the border; the stratified table makes the difference visible.
boundary_stratification.gate: census-before-seal runs on it like any new derived quantity.

kill_criteria.1_leakage: any charge's feature matrix found to contain an excluded feature -> HALT. The test fails loudly, never silently.
kill_criteria.2_power: power_check runs FIRST and GOVERNS on every contingency statistic (the standing rule). Below floor -> INSUFFICIENT, declared, not scored.
kill_criteria.3_determinism_drift: if the flag->profile map is ever not 46->46 with zero ambiguity, C3 has changed and every ceiling claim in this seal is void until re-derived.
kill_criteria.4_seal_ordering: prediction files are hashed BEFORE oracles run. If that ordering cannot be demonstrated, the arm is not scored.

G1_addendum_prospective_registry.sealed: 2026-07-25, at G1, BEFORE any model is fit. This is design, not rescue.
G1_addendum_prospective_registry.origin: The owner asked whether the 21 temporally-clean cells could be promoted to a scored holdout. RULED NO: the barrier is n, not design role — renaming an exhibit a holdout adds no rows, and G0's INSUFFICIENT declaration stands on unchanged information. But the question surfaced the real asset.
G1_addendum_prospective_registry.the_asset: Every FUTURE Gate-4 fill is temporally clean BY CONSTRUCTION: Anatomy's coordinates froze at 8ff11f8a before any future citation work exists. A model that calls open cells correctly BEFORE anyone looks up the answers is immune to every leakage story — the answer did not exist to leak. This is the strongest validation design available to the program, it compounds with every wave the atlas was going to run anyway, and it converts the promotion pipeline from maintenance into the endgame validation instrument.
G1_addendum_prospective_registry.rule_1_predict_then_fill: Before any future recruitment or fill wave's citation research begins, the current fitted Arm-B model FILES PREDICTIONS for every open cell in that wave's scope — full profiles where the model emits them, per-charge where that is what exists. Predictions are hashed and committed BEFORE the first literature query of the wave. This is the mosaic_code.py:192 seal-ordering idiom applied at WAVE granularity.
G1_addendum_prospective_registry.rule_2_blind_research: The pipeline then runs untouched: research -> dual-pass -> owner Gate-4 sitting -> promotion. The citation work proceeds BLIND to the predictions. ENFORCED BY CONSTRUCTION, not by convention: prediction files live OUTSIDE the research agents' input surface, and a test asserts it.
G1_addendum_prospective_registry.rule_3_grading: Promoted values grade against the pre-filed predictions. Retracted or open-remaining cells grade as NO-CONTEST, recorded. Every graded cell enters the registry with: prediction_hash, prediction_date, fill_date, sitting_date, verdict.

rule_4_scoring_discipline.accumulation: The registry accumulates as DECLARED-INSUFFICIENT until it clears the Cochran floor at the registry's own class spread.
rule_4_scoring_discipline.estimate: ~50-60 graded cells at current proportions — an ESTIMATE, not the threshold.
rule_4_scoring_discipline.threshold_pinning: PINNED 2026-07-25 PRE-FIT (superseding 'pin at first wave'): scored floor n>=57 (one-sided binomial, alpha=.05, power=.80, detecting +0.15 over the p0=0.643 modal baseline on n=129 real parameterized cells). The 4x4 confusion table needs n>=246 by Cochran and is DESCRIPTIVE-ONLY, declared INSUFFICIENT until then. UPDATE RULE: recompute at each wave close from realized spread; MONOTONE -- may rise, never relaxed after any grading. Full arithmetic in grid-prospective-registry.json:threshold_arithmetic.
rule_4_scoring_discipline.scores_once: At floor-clearance it scores ONCE as the sealed prospective test, against the same nulls as Arm B's retrospective run.
rule_4_scoring_discipline.no_interim_peeks: no interim scoring that could steer recruitment.
rule_4_scoring_discipline.blindness_law_extended: wave scopes are chosen by the STANDING RECRUITMENT CRITERIA (charge-citability), NEVER by where the model is confident. This is the Quarry v2 blindness law extended into prospective territory.

ships_regardless_of_either_arm: THE COVERAGE WALL: the objective axis is one charge wide (C1 + C2). A grid whose treatment is the objective has a 1-charge x 2-level design space on this universe.

THE DETERMINISM: the synthetic universe cannot test the bridge, because there the bridge is a theorem (C3). This re-centers the program — the empirical bridge question lives entirely on the natural side.
